text:
emily: Kicking off Helios POC. Requirements: streaming chat, function/tool calling, strict structured JSON output, SAML SSO, customer-managed KMS (BYOK). POC will be hosted but they want KMS control and SOC2 evidence. Also asked for cost estimate for bursty traffic: ~1k QPS bursts for 15-30m windows.

omar: Quick clarifiers: 1) Is the client flow browser-based or server-side? 2) Do they need ephemeral creds in the demo?

emily: Browser + server components. They prefer short-lived creds for security.

nina: Notes from security: Hosted with BYOK is allowed on enterprise plan; legal needs LOA + KMS attestation. SAML is supported via our IdP federation. For strict data residency or full control recommend Dedicated. SOC2 reports can be shared under NDA.

omar: SDK guidance: Node + Python have streaming + function call handlers. For browser use SSE (EventSource); for server use websocket. Function calls appear as streamed events with type function_call. Example SSE snippet: 
```js
const es = new EventSource('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/stream?model=redwood-13b', { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${KEY}` } });
es.onmessage = (e) => { const chunk = JSON.parse(e.data); if (chunk.type === 'function_call') { /* handle */ } };
```
For structured output, embed a schema in the system prompt and validate each completed JSON chunk client-side.

emily: Any known blockers?

omar: One caveat: Node SDK token rotation + SSE has a reconnection edge-case where a mid-stream token rotate can cause 401 loops. Workaround: server-side token refresh proxy that re-establishes the stream on 401 and replays any ephemeral session state. Patch in PR #1274 adds auto-refresh; CI passing soon.

nina: Operational asks: If they insist on BYOK, include lead time for legal and KMS verification in the quote. Also capture if they need audit log retention beyond default.

emily: Latency question: Helios asked if we can hit ~100ms p50 for short prompts.

omar: Hosted best-effort; Dedicated/reserved capacity hit p50 ~100ms with optimized quantized model and batch=1. Recommend prefix/KV caching and pinned model for demo to stabilize tail latency.

emily: Omar, can you produce a one-page runbook with: SSE example, websocket fallback, handling function_call chunks, schema validation example, and token rotation workaround? Include a sample cost calc for the burst scenario.

omar: On it. Ill attach a quickstart repo link and a simple spreadsheet.

ci-bot: PR #1274 opened by @omar - "sse-auto-refresh-credentials" (CI checks running).

emily: Great. Nina please prepare the security questionnaire answers and list any legal addenda. I'll schedule a Wed demo with Helios (emma@helios.com). :thumbsup:
